test_tdi_resolution: test the TimedeltaIndex.resolution property returns the correct resolution string for a single timedelta value
test_tdi_resolution_no_freq: test the TimedeltaIndex.resolution property works correctly when the index has no freq attribute set
create_tdi_resolution_day: create a TimedeltaIndex with a single day value and verify its resolution property equals 'day'
create_tdi_resolution_hour: create a TimedeltaIndex with mixed day and hour values and verify its resolution property equals 'hour'
test_tdi_resolution_microsecond: test the TimedeltaIndex.resolution property returns 'microsecond' for a single microsecond timedelta value
